utest.reason: uTest permits limited generic AI assistance but prohibits sending confidential/client/personal data to external AI tools. This agent therefore never automates project acceptance or project execution on uTest.

testio.reason: Test IO testing standards prohibit automated tools/scripts that compromise testing integrity. This agent is limited to opportunity triage and manual preparation.

testlio.reason: Testlio restricts public/external AI while performing services unless expressly authorized. This agent does not execute Testlio project work.

testbirds.reason: No explicit permission for autonomous acceptance/execution is assumed. Human review is required before any project action.

testerwork.reason: No explicit permission for autonomous acceptance/execution is assumed. Human review is required before any project action.

generic-authorized.reason: Browser testing is allowed only when the operator explicitly confirms authorization for the target.

opire.reason: Opire rewards are resolved through public GitHub issues/PRs. Discovery and repository analysis can be automated, but /try, /claim, and PR submission remain explicit external actions.

algora.reason: Algora supports GitHub issue bounties and has public examples of AI-assisted claims, but claiming/submitting is still an external commitment and stays human-approved.
